QueueCreateDialog.title: New queue
QueueCreateDialog.departmentHelperText: Organizational label only — doesn't restrict who can pick up work here.
QueueCreateDialog.assignmentStrategyHelperText: Manual: conversations wait for an agent to pick them up. Round robin/Least load assign automatically.
QueueCreateDialog.slaPolicyHelperText: Optional — overrides the targets below with a reusable policy (business hours, warning threshold, escalation). See SLA Builder.
QueueCreateDialog.firstResponseTargetHelperText: Leave blank for no first-response SLA on this queue. Ignored while an SLA policy above is set.
QueueCreateDialog.resolutionTargetHelperText: Leave blank for no resolution SLA on this queue. Ignored while an SLA policy above is set.
QueueCreateDialog.autopilotHelperText: Let AI reply to conversations in this queue automatically, handing off to an agent when it isn't confident. Also requires Autopilot to be turned on in Settings → AI.

QueueEditDialog.departmentHelperText: Organizational label only — doesn't restrict who can pick up work here.
QueueEditDialog.slaOwnedByService: Response time targets for this queue are set by the <serviceLink>{{service}}</serviceLink> service, which handles this queue. Edit them there — this screen can no longer change them.

QueuesPage.pageDescription: Decide where new conversations go, and how they're assigned to agents.
QueuesPage.routingRulesInfoText: A new conversation is routed to the first active rule (in priority order) whose conditions match. Conversations that match no rule aren't routed to a queue.
QueuesPage.emptyQueuesDescription: Create your first queue to start routing conversations.
QueuesPage.deleteQueueBlockedReason: {{count}} routing rule(s) still target this queue — repoint them before deleting it.
QueuesPage.removeQueueDialogDescription: Remove {{name}}? Conversations currently in this queue keep their history but will no longer route through it. This cannot be undone.
QueuesPage.emptyRulesDescription: New conversations with no matching rule aren't routed to a queue automatically.
QueuesPage.removeRuleDialogDescription: Remove this routing rule? New conversations matching it will fall through to the next rule instead. This cannot be undone.

RoutingRuleCreateDialog.title: New routing rule
RoutingRuleCreateDialog.priorityHelperText: Lower numbers are evaluated first — the first matching rule wins.
RoutingRuleCreateDialog.channelTypeHelperText: Leave as 'Any channel' to match every channel type.
RoutingRuleCreateDialog.bodyContainsHelperText: Optional — matches if the first message contains this text (case-insensitive).
